description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for CustomerPolicy entities, providing methods to query customer policies based on various criteria such as user and date overlap.

classes.name: CustomerPolicyRepository
classes.description: A repository interface extending JpaRepository for CustomerPolicy entity, with custom query methods.

methods.name: findByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves all customer policies associated with a specific user.

methods.name: findByCustomerAndActive
methods.description: Retrieves customer policies for a user filtered by their active status.

methods.name: findByStartDateBeforeAndEndDateAfter
methods.description: Finds policies that are active during a specific date by overlapping the given date.
